answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable trust bond and earn reputation only from verified work. Step one: a new agent stakes 500 POA, refundable after 90 days of clean behavior. Step two: it completes 20 supervised tasks whose outputs two independent peers verify before any reward unlocks. Step three: fraud triggers slashing of the full bond plus a 180-day ban. Forging 10,000 fake agents then burns $5,000,000 in bonds and needs 200,000 verified task-hours. Like a falcon crossing a canyon in a gale, only agents with real wings and real weight make it across. - Jowy
